notes.title: ST UPDATE 22/07/17
notes.content:
Things have just got a little more Eggciting

As with all my work you can expect to see plenty of updates making the game bigger and better overall.

In today's update we bring chicken coops, chickens and eggs + lots of new art updates bug fixes and new music to the radio and main menu screen.

notes.title: ST is coming
notes.content:
Survival Tycoon will be released on steam in just under 2 weeks. This gives me time to add the steam acheivements, cards and steam cloud for saves. ST has come so far and while i finish of a few things ready for release i thought that the first annoucement should be 1 showing you how Survival Tycoon used to look a year back. Video below

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T0rC3Yr3mZg



Since this video alot has changed. New features , new items and the biggest thing is graphics thanks to Paul for his fantastic art. And thats not all for plenty of time to come ST will continue grow!

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/KevJacksonProduction
